parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the following terms:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
Iodide ions react with peroxydisulfate ions.

$$2\text{I}^- + \text{S}_2\text{O}_8^{2-} \rightarrow \text{I}_2 + 2\text{SO}_4^{2-}$$

This reaction is slow, but it is catalysed by $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ ions.

Write two equations to explain how this reaction is catalysed by $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ ions.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why the alternative route in the presence of $\text{Fe}^{2+}$ ions has a lower activation energy than the route in the absence of a catalyst.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Nitrogen monoxide reacts with oxygen.

$$2\text{NO}(\text{g}) + \text{O}_2(\text{g}) \rightarrow 2\text{NO}_2(\text{g})$$

This reaction is second order with respect to nitrogen monoxide and first order with respect to oxygen.

Under certain conditions the value of the rate constant, $k$, is $8.60 \times 10^6 \text{ mol}^{-2} \text{ dm}^6 \text{ s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Construct the rate equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the initial rate of the reaction under these conditions when the initial concentration of nitrogen monoxide is $7.20 \times 10^{-4} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ and the initial concentration of oxygen is $1.90 \times 10^{-3} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The drug cisplatin, $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$, hydrolyses in water.

$$\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2 + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightarrow [\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}(\text{H}_2\text{O})]^+ + \text{Cl}^-$$

The rate equation is shown.

$$\text{rate} = k[\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2]$$

The value of $k$ is $2.50 \times 10^{-5} \text{ s}^{-1}$ under certain conditions.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text:
This reaction has a constant half-life.

Explain why this is the case.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Use the information in this question to show that the half-life of this reaction is $2.77 \times 10^4 \text{ s}$.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
$8.00 \times 10^{-6}$ moles of $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$ are added to $100 \text{ cm}^3$ of water.

Calculate the time taken for the concentration of $\text{Pt}(\text{NH}_3)_2\text{Cl}_2$ to fall to $2.50 \times 10^{-6} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$.
